name: XLA_SEG_RULE_DETAILS_
description: This table contains the account rule details information.

columns.name: SEGMENT_RULE_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_COA_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the chart of accounts that is associated to the ledger that owns the journal entry.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a functional area within a software suite of products. For example: Financials, or Payroll.

columns.name: AMB_CONTEXT_CODE
columns.description: Accounting methods builder context.

columns.name: SEGMENT_RULE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the account rule is seeded.

columns.name: SEGMENT_RULE_CODE
columns.description: An abbreviated name of a rule that derives account combination values for a journal entry line.

columns.name: USER_SEQUENCE
columns.description: Number assigned by the user to indicate the priority of the rule.

columns.name: VALUE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the types of value used in the account rule

columns.name: VALUE_SOURCE_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Application identifier of the source.

columns.name: VALUE_SOURCE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether a seeded source

columns.name: VALUE_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Short name of the transaction information that is used to create journal entries.

columns.name: VALUE_SOURCE_ORIGIN_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the subledger source or formula is predefined.

columns.name: VALUE_CONSTANT
columns.description: Literal value assigned to an account rule detail.

columns.name: VALUE_CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Accounting code combination identifier.

columns.name: VALUE_MAPPING_SET_CODE
columns.description: Abbreviated name of amapping rule that is defined based on input source values to target segment or account.

columns.name: VALUE_FLEXFIELD_SEGMENT_CODE
columns.description: Abbreviated name of an accounting flexfield segment.

columns.name: INPUT_SOURCE_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Not currently used.

columns.name: INPUT_SOURCE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Not currently used.

columns.name: INPUT_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Not currently used.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: VALUE_SEGMENT_RULE_APPL_ID
columns.description: Application identifier of the linked Account Rule

columns.name: VALUE_SEGMENT_RULE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the linked account rule is a seeded rule

columns.name: VALUE_SEGMENT_RULE_CODE
columns.description: Short name of another account rule assigned as a value in an account rule definition.

columns.name: VALUE_ADR_VERSION_NUM
columns.description: Version number of the linked account rule

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.
